## Description
Provide a clear description of the modifications, the rationale, and the specific component affected (e.g., frontend, backend, firmware).

## Changes Type
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Restructuring / Refactoring (non-breaking architecture changes)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Verification Performed
Describe the verification process and include relevant commands/logs.
- [ ] Workspace builds successfully (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Ingestion flow verified with Python Bridge
- [ ] Dashboard charts render correctly
- [ ] PDF report export works

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code standards of this project.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] I have updated the types in `shared/types.ts` if fields changed.
- [ ] No secrets or keys are exposed in configuration files.
